ROOT.proceduredef: CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.DodajDoRodzicow(@ID int,@Typ smallint,@Firma int,@Numer int,@Lp smallint) AS BEGIN CREATE TABLE #rodzice (FRS_ID INT UNIQUE,Poziom INT) insert into #rodzice exec cdn.frmrodzice @ID insert into cdn.frmobiekty (FRO_FRMID, FRO_GIDTyp, FRO_GIDFirma, FRO_GIDNumer, FRO_GIDLp, FRO_GID2Typ, FRO_GID2Firma, FRO_GID2Numer, FRO_GID2Lp) select FRS_ID,@Typ,@Firma,@Numer,@Lp,0,0,0,0 from #rodzice where not exists (select * from cdn.frmobiekty where FRO_GIDTyp=@typ and FRO_GIDFirma=@Firma and FRO_GIDNumer=@Numer and FRO_GIDLp=@Lp and FRO_FRMID=#rodzice.FRS_ID) AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.FrmObiekty WHERE FRO_FRMID=#rodzice.FRS_ID AND FRO_GIDTyp=@Typ) drop table #rodzice END
